title: TBI reproducibility pipeline: frozen reanalysis of six public transcriptomic datasets
description: R pipeline for the preregistered systematic reanalysis (OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/GFDJR). Frozen parameters are in 00_config.R; the archived release contains the code actually executed, including the 26-27 October 2026 input-scale and split-feasibility fixes, the gene-level statistics, H5 literature-check and figure scripts, and the corresponding input tables.
